title: JavaScript Variables and Scope knowledge check

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of a precise TypeScript type?
options: To convert or sanitize an external value at runtime.
To express the intended values and let the compiler detect incompatible uses.
questions.answer_key: To express the intended values and let the compiler detect incompatible uses.
questions.explanation: Types describe expected program values but do not automatically change or validate runtime data.

questions.prompt: Which statement is correct about “JavaScript Variables and Scope”?
options: A type assertion automatically validates every value at runtime.
The learner should publish hidden solutions so the exercise can grade itself.
The concept should be demonstrated with let , const , and legacy var and checked against its intended contract.
The safest approach is to skip diagnostics and trust the first output.
questions.answer_key: The concept should be demonstrated with let , const , and legacy var and checked against its intended contract.
questions.explanation: The supplied syllabus explicitly includes “let , const , and legacy var”; connect it to a concrete example and verify the behavior relevant to this lesson.

questions.prompt: What is a good verification step after practicing “JavaScript Variables and Scope”?
options: Treat passing a static token check as proof that the program executed correctly.
Check block scope and function scope, include a meaningful failure case where appropriate, and document any runtime or version assumptions.
Assume hoisting and temporal dead zones is unnecessary because the code has type annotations.
Ignore compiler or test failures if the interface looks correct.
questions.answer_key: Check block scope and function scope, include a meaningful failure case where appropriate, and document any runtime or version assumptions.
questions.explanation: The syllabus includes “Block scope and function scope”. Verification should match the concept: type-level checks, runtime tests, configuration checks or human review as appropriate.
